update.mustText: This version is too old to use safely. The update is free and keeps your family's data safe.
update.mayText: Update for the latest fixes and features.

maintenance.title: Back very soon
maintenance.text: AYWO is being improved. Please try again in a little while. Your family's data is safe.

crash.title: Something went wrong
crash.text: This screen stopped working. We've been told and will fix it. Your family's data is safe.

sos.label: SOS. Hold for 2 seconds to alert your family.
sos.hint: Hold for 2 seconds. Your SOS contacts hear an alarm at once.
sos.title: SOS
sos.sub: Hold 2 seconds to alert your family
sos.explain: Hold the bar for 2 seconds. A tap alone does nothing.

report.why: What's wrong? AYWO staff will look within 24 hours. The person won't know who reported it.
report.selfHarm: If someone may be in danger right now, call 112 or use SOS.
report.blockHelp: You won't see each other's memories or messages.
report.thanks: We'll look at it within 24 hours and act if it breaks the AYWO rules.
report.thanksBlocked: We'll look at it within 24 hours. {{name}} is blocked.

block.title: Block {{name}}?
block.text: You won't see each other's memories, comments or messages, and they can't start a chat with you. They aren't told.
block.unblockText: You'll see each other's memories and messages again.
block.listSubtitle: People you blocked can't chat with you, and you don't see each other's posts.

help.title: Help centre
help.subtitle: Quick answers, or ask AYWO Support.
help.safetyNote: If someone is in danger now, use SOS or call 112. Support answers within a day.
help.subject: In a few words
help.closedNote: This is closed. Write again to open it.
help.replyTime: We usually answer within a day.

offers.title: Offers
offers.subtitle: Codes for printed posters, family books and premium invites.
offers.none: No offers right now. Check back soon.

orders.title: My orders
orders.subtitle: Where your posters and books are.

shop.title: Order a poster or book
shop.subtitle: Your family tree, printed and sent home.

about.tree_poster: A large printed poster of your family tree, with names and photos.
about.family_book: A printed book with your family tree, people and memories.

shop.name: Name
shop.addressAbroad: You'll enter the address on the secure payment page.
shop.cancelled: Payment wasn't finished. Nothing was charged.
shop.secure: Payment happens on Razorpay's or Stripe's own secure page. AYWO never sees your card or UPI details.
shop.thanks: Your payment is being confirmed. You'll get a notification at each step, and can follow it in My orders.

refer.title: Invite and earn
refer.subtitle: Bring family and friends to AYWO. You both get 30 days of AYWO Plus.
refer.message: Join our family on AYWO. Use my code {{code}} for 30 free days of AYWO Plus: {{link}}
refer.step1: 1. Share your code or link with someone new to AYWO.
refer.step2: 2. They sign up and join or build a family tree.
refer.step3: 3. You both get {{days}} days of AYWO Plus, free.
refer.gotCodeHelp: If someone invited you, type their code. It works in your first 14 days.
refer.claimed: Thanks! {{name}} invited you. Your free days start once you're in a family tree.
refer.fine: Up to 12 rewards a year. Free days are added on top of any Plus you have.

card.title: Emergency card
card.subtitle: What helpers should know if you send an SOS.
card.noteHint: For example: hearing aid, speaks Tamil only
card.who: Only the people your SOS reaches see this, while it runs and for a day after.
card.sosNote: Blood group, allergies and medicines, shown to helpers during an SOS.

prefs.offers: Send me offers and news from AYWO
prefs.offersHelp: At most a couple a week. Safety alerts and SOS always reach you, whatever you choose here.
prefs.emailCheck: Confirm {{email}} to get emails from AYWO. We send a 6-digit code.

errors.coupon_invalid: That code isn't valid. Check the spelling.
errors.coupon_expired: That code has ended or hasn't started yet.
errors.coupon_not_for_product: That code doesn't work for this item.
errors.coupon_min_amount: Add a little more to use this code.
errors.coupon_new_users_only: That code is for a first order only.
errors.coupon_used_up: That code has been fully used.
errors.referral_invalid: That code isn't right. Check it with the person who invited you.
errors.referral_too_late: Codes work only in your first 14 days on AYWO.
errors.referral_already: You've already used an invite code.
errors.chat_blocked: You can't send messages in this chat.
errors.email_code_wrong: That code isn't right, or it has expired. Ask for a new one.
